message.reasoning: We need to fill the fuel tank. The tank holds up to 50 gallons. We currently have 10 liters. Need to convert liters to gallons. 1 liter ≈ 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters ≈ 2.64172 gallons. But we want to fill up the tank fully. The tank capacity is 50 gallons. So we need to add 50 - current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We only know liters. Let's convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So we need to add 47.35828 gallons. But maybe we can just fill the tank to full. The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 47.36 (rounded).
